### Now Arriving at The North Kohl’s: November Holiday Savings Events


10/30/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s204.q4cdn.com/271435555/files/doc_news/Now-Arriving-at-The-North-Kohls-November-Holiday-Savings-Events-2026.pdf)


- *Deals start Friday, Nov. 6, with a selection of offers across gifts, décor, apparel, home, and tech, many at 50% off or more*
- *Stores open at 5 a.m. local time** on Black Friday; the first 200 shoppers at every Kohl’s store can receive $5 to $100 in instant Kohl’s Cash*+*
- *For the first time, the first 200 shoppers at every Kohl’s store on Saturday, Nov. 28, will receive an instant Sephora at Kohl’s promotional gift**+ valued from $5 to $100 to use on eligible beauty purchases that day in store*


MENOMONEE FALLS, Wis.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Kohl’s (NYSE: KSS) is helping families make the most of their holiday budgets with thousands of deals, gifts at $5, $10, $15, and $20, Kohl’s Cash, and chances to win prizes. The retailer’s three November savings events include Black Friday Early Access, Nov. 6–8; Black Friday Week, Nov. 22–28; and Cyber Deals, Nov. 29–30.


**Early Access Black Friday Savings Start Nov. 6–8** Kohl’s[Black Friday Early Access event](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kohls.com%2Fsale-event%2Fearly-access-black-friday.jsp&esheet=54631579&newsitemid=20261030050745&lan=en-US&anchor=Black+Friday+Early+Access+event&index=1&md5=3a437c39dde284b8b63fc0046a4926dd) starts Fri., Nov. 6, through Sun. Nov. 8, featuring thousands of items across cozy essentials, festive style, holiday home finds, and top gifts — many at 50% off or more. Shoppers can also:


- Take an additional 20% off their qualifying purchase with a coupon*
- Earn $15 Kohl’s Cash⁺ for every $50 spent only on Nov. 6
- Earn $10 Kohl’s Cash⁺ for every $50 spent from Nov. 7-8
- Explore Kohl’s Daily Deals, offering shoppers limited-time, daily deal drops every day of the event


**Black Friday Week: Nov. 22–28** Kohl’s[Black Friday Week event](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kohls.com%2Fsale-event%2Fblack-friday-deals.jsp&esheet=54631579&newsitemid=20261030050745&lan=en-US&anchor=Black+Friday+Week+event&index=2&md5=269373f2512a59fdb97f9551bb57c63f) begins Sun., Nov. 22, through Sat., Nov. 28. Stores will be closed Thanksgiving Day, Thursday, Nov. 26, and reopen at 5 a.m. local time on Friday, Nov. 27**. During the week-long event, shoppers can:


- Take an additional 20% off qualifying purchases*
- Earn $15 in Kohl’s Cash *⁺* for every $50 spent ***
- Shop limited-time doorbusters featuring some of the season’s hottest styles, available on[Kohls.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fkohls.com&esheet=54631579&newsitemid=20261030050745&lan=en-US&anchor=Kohls.com&index=3&md5=e392f5d431792ea6333672d80db028c6) beginning Thanksgiving Day, Thurs., Nov. 26 at 12:01 a.m. CT, and in stores Fri., Nov. 27 through Sat., Nov. 28.


Additional Black Friday highlights include:


- **Black Friday Kohl’s Cash Giveaway:** The first 200 shoppers at every Kohl’s store nationwide on Friday, Nov 27, will receive $5 to $100 in instant Kohl’s Cash*⁺, while supplies last.
- **NEW Sephora at Kohl’s Giveaway:** For the first time ever, on Saturday, Nov. 28, the first 200 shoppers at every Kohl’s store will receive an instant Sephora at Kohl's promotional gift ****⁺* , in the form of a coupon worth $5 to $100, to use on beauty purchases that day in store.
- **Black Friday Sweepstakes:** From Friday, Nov. 27 - Monday, Nov. 30, shoppers in-store and online can enter for a chance to win prizes, including Kohl’s gift cards, The North Kohl’s product bundles, and a $10,000 cash grand prize. ***⁺*


**Cyber Deals: Nov. 29–30** Kohl’s Cyber Deals start Sun., Nov. 29, through Mon., Nov. 30, featuring 40% off qualifying purchases with a coupon*, up to 50% off deals, and $15 Kohl’s Cash for every $50 spent+.


For more Kohl’s news and to stay up to date on all the holiday happenings at Kohl’s, visit[Corporate.Kohls.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcorporate.kohls.com%2Fholiday&esheet=54631579&newsitemid=20261030050745&lan=en-US&anchor=Corporate.Kohls.com&index=4&md5=f27376432997866d4cf158fe4a15c52e) .


*⁺Kohl's Cash* ® *terms and exclusions apply. Not valid on Sephora at Kohl’s. Earn amount of Kohl's Cash* ® *is approximate and may vary if additional coupons are applied to the purchase transaction. See coupon or ask an associate for details.*


**Present coupon in-store or enter code on Kohls.com. Refer to the specific offers for terms and exclusions or ask an associate for details.*


***Store hours may vary by location. See[Kohls.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2FKohls.com&esheet=54631579&newsitemid=20261030050745&lan=en-US&anchor=Kohls.com&index=5&md5=3a47d1f7e9946f9dd980a331f11a1941) for details.*


**⁺PROMOTIONAL KOHL'S CASH® REDEEMABLE IN STORE ONLY FOR ONE TRANSACTION SAME DAY OF RECEIPT*


*Kohl's Cash® is not legal tender. No cash back. PROMOTIONAL KOHL'S CASH® REDEEM: Can be redeemed for one transaction during the stated redeem window with any other coupon; any unused amount will be forfeited. Limit of 1 per transaction. KOHL'S CASH® AND OTHER DOLLAR-OFF COUPONS WILL BE APPLIED PRIOR TO PERCENT-OFF TOTAL PURCHASE COUPONS. Kohl's Cash® may not be redeemed on (1) Sephora at Kohl’s merchandise; (2) Kohl's Cares® cause merchandise or other charitable items; (3) Gift Cards; (4) price adjustments; (5) payments to a Kohl's credit card or any third-party charge account; or (6) any services or fees, including taxes and shipping. RETURN VALUE OF MERCHANDISE PURCHASED WITH THIS PROMOTIONAL KOHL'S CASH® WILL BE SUBJECT TO ADJUSTMENT. RETURN KOHL’S CASH WILL NOT BE ISSUED UPON RETURN OF MERCHANDISE OR CANCELLATION OF ORDER. Nontransferable. See associate for details.*


***⁺NO PURCHASE NECESSARY. A PURCHASE WILL NOT INCREASE YOUR CHANCES OF WINNING. Open only to legal residents of the 50 US/DC, 18 years of age and older. Void where prohibited by law. Sweepstakes starts at 5:00 a.m. ET on 11/27/26 and ends at 11:59 p.m. ET on 11/30/26. Subject to the Official Rules, including how to enter, prize details, odds, and restrictions, see KohlsBlackFriday.com/rules. Sponsor: Kohl’s, Inc., N56 W17000 Ridgewood Drive, Menomonee Falls, WI 53051.*


****⁺NO PURCHASE NECESSARY. Open to legal residents of 50 US/DC, 18+. Cards available 11/28/26 at participating Sephora at Kohl’s locations. Cards are distributed in-person on a first-come, first-served basis starting at store opening, and only while supplies last. Limit 1 card per household. Coupon redemption is only available in-store at a Sephora at Kohl’s location on 11/28/26. Coupon value varies between $5 and $100. Subject to Terms & Conditions. See store associate for T&Cs. Sponsor: Kohl’s, Inc.*


**About Kohl's**


Kohl’s (NYSE: KSS) is a leading omnichannel retailer built on a foundation that combines great brands, incredible value and convenience for our customers. Kohl’s is uniquely positioned to deliver against its long-term strategy and its purpose to take care of families’ realest moments. Kohl's serves millions of families in its more than 1,100 stores in 49 states, online at[Kohls.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fkohls.com&esheet=54631579&newsitemid=20261030050745&lan=en-US&anchor=Kohls.com&index=6&md5=29b8b8c5d1943801fc71f593d3ae0535) , and through the Kohl's App. With a large national footprint, Kohl’s is committed to making a positive impact in the communities it serves. For a list of store locations or to shop online, visit Kohls.com. For more information about Kohl’s impact in the community or how to join our winning team, visit[Corporate.Kohls.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fcorporate.kohls.com&esheet=54631579&newsitemid=20261030050745&lan=en-US&anchor=Corporate.Kohls.com&index=7&md5=1aebc161d7a9bd266d3c8dc2558689c7) .
